description: Read any page of e-vignettes.eu as Markdown, without parsing HTML. Useful for the editorial pages the structured tools do not cover: /about, /contact, /privacy, /terms, /partner, /developers, /tollboxes and the blog. Pass the path only, for example /partner or /about-at.

path.description: Site path beginning with a slash, for example "/" or "/partner".

name: read_page
title: Read a page as Markdown
